business_problem: Koibanx's rigid SQL environment, slow blockchain lookups, and growing regional demand made it hard to scale secure digital-asset and payment services for banking customers across Latin America.
solution_summary: Koibanx migrated from rigid SQL systems to MongoDB Atlas to power a fintech platform that bridges digital assets, blockchain workflows, and traditional banking services across Latin America. Atlas acts as the hot-storage and transaction backbone: instead of querying slow blockchains for every status change, Koibanx stores operational state in MongoDB so users can instantly retrieve order progress, while its ledger module uses Atlas queries and high availability to support central accounting. Separate services keep their own databases, and MongoDB's distributed-transaction support preserves consistency across asset issuance, exchange, conversion, and rewards workflows. Built-in encryption, access controls, and cloud reliability let Koibanx scale financial products, absorb traffic spikes, and keep customer-facing performance high while supporting compliance-sensitive data.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Serves as Koibanx's hot storage, transaction backbone, and ledger data store for its fintech platform.

data_flow: Blockchain and banking workflows write transaction state into MongoDB Atlas, which acts as hot storage so customer-facing services can retrieve order status immediately. Atlas also backs the ledger module and distributed transactions across separate service databases that connect fiat, crypto, and rewards workflows.
business_outcome: MongoDB Atlas eliminated performance complaints, improved cloud reliability, handled reward runs of up to 4.5 million transactions in 10 minutes, and gave Koibanx a more scalable and secure base for digital-asset growth.
metrics: With just two clicks the performance of the system improved.
